text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* The centre-right opposition bloc triumphed in a mayoral election in Milan but lost in Turin and Trieste to the centre-left parties that back the ruling coalition (all).

* Marxist Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti said the local election results should make centre-left Olive Tree majority coalition reflect about the importance of its hard left ally (all).

* In an interview, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said Italy was not late in presenting the economic convergence programme for European single currency, since it had already agreed with the European Commission to present it after the DPEF which will be completed in coming days (Corriere della Sera)

* Prime minister Romano Prodi said the letter from Brussel about cuts to public sector spending was mere routine and it did not mean Italy had failed any exam to qualify for European Monetary Union (all).
** Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
